summary: Third-party service abuse tool (Garena Free Fire account generator)
details: Package implements bulk creation of Garena Free Fire guest accounts against Garena's own endpoints (100067.connect.garena.com, loginbp.ggblueshark.com, loginbp.common.ggbluefox.com), using randomized X-Forwarded-For headers, WAF-bypass user agents, and hardcoded protocol crypto keys for the MajorRegister/MajorLogin flow. Behavior targets a third-party gaming service and violates that service's terms of use. The package contains no install-time or import-time network activity, no exfiltration of installer data, no credential theft from the installer, no dropper, and no backdoor. Installing or importing the package does not compromise the installer's environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
